caption: The drawing depicts a trivet with an ornate, openwork pattern. The main body of the trivet is roughly heart-shaped with a flat, elongated handle extending from one end, ending in a circular design with a six-pointed star inside. The interior of the main, leaf-shaped section consists of geometric patterns, including several six-pointed stars contained within circular frames, connected by curved and straight bands that form symmetrical arches and loops. The trivet is supported by three short legs visible beneath it. The colors in the drawing are mainly shades of gray and black, indicating a metallic material. The drawing includes three views: a large, angled perspective view in the foreground; and in the upper left corner, smaller plan and elevation views, as well as a short scale for measurement. Thin double borders enclose the composition, and the artist's name "T. GRUASTEIN" is inscribed in the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Flat-iron Holder
